title: OBSERVATION
author: Manjula Asthana Mahanti
text:
Observation carries many questions
Listening only, can`t tackle the answers
Observation, keenly, is a serious matter
Hearing than listening is much better
Everyone has, inside , a volcano
It`s most important to sattle with your volcano
Be a friend of yourself,
Forget ego, satisfy the quench of answers in yourself
Your own thoughts spin a web of problems
Misunderstanding,
It`s necessary to hear & observe
Don`t just listen only......
